INVALID_REQUEST.title: This request is not valid
INVALID_REQUEST.description: The Deal audit request could not be understood.
INVALID_REQUEST.action: Refresh the Deal and try again.

AUTHENTICATION_FAILED.title: Line Item Watch could not authenticate
AUTHENTICATION_FAILED.description: HubSpot could not authorize this audit request.
AUTHENTICATION_FAILED.action: Refresh the Deal. If the problem continues, reconnect the app.

ACCOUNT_UNAVAILABLE.title: Line Item Watch is unavailable for this account
ACCOUNT_UNAVAILABLE.description: The account is not currently able to use Deal audit history.
ACCOUNT_UNAVAILABLE.action: Ask an administrator to check the app connection and entitlement.

SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE.title: Audit history is temporarily unavailable
SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE.description: Line Item Watch could not reach its audit store.
SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE.action: Try again in a few moments.

INTERNAL_ERROR.title: Audit history could not be loaded
INTERNAL_ERROR.description: Line Item Watch encountered an unexpected problem.
INTERNAL_ERROR.action: Try again. If the problem continues, share the reference with support.

NETWORK.title: Could not connect to Line Item Watch
NETWORK.description: The audit request did not reach the service.
NETWORK.action: Check your connection and try again.

TIMEOUT.title: The audit request timed out
TIMEOUT.description: Line Item Watch did not respond in time.

RATE_LIMITED.title: Too many audit requests
RATE_LIMITED.description: Line Item Watch is temporarily limiting requests.
RATE_LIMITED.action: Wait a moment, then try again.

MALFORMED_RESPONSE.title: Audit history could not be displayed
MALFORMED_RESPONSE.description: The service returned data that this card cannot safely display.
MALFORMED_RESPONSE.action: Try again. If the problem continues, contact support.

LOCAL_CONFIGURATION.title: Line Item Watch is not configured
LOCAL_CONFIGURATION.description: The API origin is missing or invalid for this HubSpot project profile.
LOCAL_CONFIGURATION.action: Ask an administrator to configure LINE_ITEM_WATCH_API_ORIGIN.

LOCAL_CONTEXT.title: This Deal could not be identified
LOCAL_CONTEXT.description: HubSpot did not provide a valid Deal identifier to the card.
LOCAL_CONTEXT.action: Refresh the Deal and reopen the card.
